import csv
import io


def parse_records(text):
    """Parse CSV text into a list of rows.

    Uses the standard csv module semantics: commas inside quoted fields are
    literal data, CRLF (and LF) line endings are accepted, and newlines inside
    quoted fields are preserved. Empty (or blank) text yields no records.
    """
    if not text:
        return []
    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text, newline="")))
